world_news.headline: Berlin approves bid to host Olympics on 100th anniversary of Nazi-run Games
world_news.summary: Berlin's state parliament approves a bid to host the Olympics in 2036, on the 100-year anniversary of the Games hosted by Adolf Hitler and the Nazis.

world_news.headline: Board of Peace envoy warns ‘permanent’ Gaza divide under current status quo
world_news.summary: UN Security Council urged to press for Israeli obligations and Hamas disarmament under Gaza 'ceasefire' roadmap.

world_news.headline: Ronaldo scores twice to seal Saudi Pro League at last with Al-Nassr
world_news.summary: Portugal forward Cristiano Ronaldo leads Al-Nassr to Saudi Pro League title in last game before World Cup 2026.

world_news.headline: Ebola treatment hospital burned down in DRC as outbreak spreads
world_news.summary: Protesters set a hospital on fire in the Democratic of Congo, as authorities struggle to contain an Ebola outbreak.

world_news.headline: NYC launches lottery for $50 World Cup football tickets
world_news.summary: New York City is launching a lottery for 1,000 discounted World Cup tickets priced at $50.

world_news.headline: Danes try to tow dead whale from island beach after failed German rescue
world_news.summary: An environmental team want to move the whale from Anholt to the Danish mainland, but they have had to pause the operation.

world_news.headline: Flotilla activists recount Israeli violence as they arrive in Turkiye
world_news.summary: Activists from the Global Sumud Flotilla arrived in Istanbul on Thursday and described Israeli violence.

world_news.headline: Angry crowd sets Ebola hospital tents on fire in DR Congo
world_news.summary: Grieving relatives and friends of a suspected Ebola victim were prevented from taking his body for burial.

world_news.headline: US sanctions elected Hezbollah MPs and Lebanese security officials
world_news.summary: Hezbollah says the sanctions will have 'absolutely no effect' on its strategy amid ongoing Israeli attacks on Lebanon.

world_news.headline: Fans create AI-generated team songs ahead of World Cup
world_news.summary: Fan-made football anthems are raking in millions of plays on social media, rivalling FIFA commissions from musicians.
